{{Quote|The weapon can create volcanoes?''"<br />"''That was an unexpected side effect! This planet is obviously unstable!|[[Reynar]] and [[Onn]]|<ref name="Deadly Allies" />}}
'''Antolus I''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sarka sector/Legends|Sarka sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
Antolus I [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a dying [[Star/Legends|star]] and was the sole [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of its [[Antolus system/Legends|system]]. It laid in a [[Sarka sector/Legends|sector]] with frequent meteor activity, meaning that [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in the area required a [[magnetogravitic shield]] in order to stay intact. The arid planet seemed lifeless but was in fact inhabited by deadly [[Insect/Legends|insects]] that lived underground.

==History==
[[File:Antolus_I_volcano.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The volcano created by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] experimental [[Land mine/Legends|land mine]].]]
Although unimportant by any standard, Antolus I was the site of a [[Battle of Antolus I|battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the confrontation, the Separatists tested a new type of [[Land mine/Legends|land mine]] with such a destructive power that it created a [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on the unstable [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Although both parties first fought to the point of reaching a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian standoff|standoff]], the unexpected side effect of the weapon compelled the Republic and Separatist forces to temporarily forgo their enmity, and work together to leave the planet alive.
